summary: Shows the community.general.merge_variables lookup to merge all variables matching a prefix, suffix or regex.
questions: How do I merge all variables that end with a certain suffix?
Is there a way to combine variables by name pattern?

answer_card.title: Merging variables by pattern
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
merged_variable: "{{ lookup('community.general.merge_variables', '__my_pattern', pattern_type='suffix') }}"
```

`pattern_type` can match prefixes, suffixes or regular expressions. Requires community.general.
